claim_being_audited: That the current release can be certified now on the basis of aggregate readiness, despite a documented subgroup regression, because certification policy is satisfied if the limitation is treated as a model-card caveat and prior approval plus informal monitoring are used only as context.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses must be disclosed in the current release documentation or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals may inform context but cannot substitute for current evidence.
Informal monitoring notes may indicate contemplated operations work but do not constitute reviewed mitigation or risk acceptance.
A present-tense certification decision needs evidence of the actual release artifact, not only a summary of what it should contain.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or certification packet showing the present evaluation results are included.
Provide the exact current-release disclosure of the developer-support migration subgroup weakness.
Provide evidence of an approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance if certification is being asserted without full disclosure.
Provide the final certification artifact version tied to this release, not the approval from four months ago.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results, but the available summary does not show that the current model-card packet actually contains the present eval batch and subgroup limitation.
The developer-support migration regression is described as material, yet there is no admissible evidence of an approved mitigation or of completed disclosure in the release documentation.
The actor correctly limits prior approval and the informal monitoring comment to background context, but those items cannot close the policy gap.
The packet appears to support a conditional conclusion: certification could be supportable after required disclosure is present. It does not fully support certification on the present record.
unsupported_claims: The claim that certification is supportable on the present record.
The claim that the required model-card caveat and monitoring commitment are already documented in the current release packet.
Any implication that informal monitoring commentary constitutes reviewed risk acceptance or approved mitigation.
